subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add owner/human handoff for DM auto-reply, and should the first supported scope be WhatsApp-only or a shared channel contract covering Telegram and Discord too?
rationale: The request adds channel config and delivery-suppression state that changes message behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
options.body: Add the behavior to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live proof and a future path to generalize if users need it across channels.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a common handoff API and implement WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord together, accepting a larger compatibility and review surface.

options.title: Defer feature
options.body: Keep current prompt/manual-policy workarounds until stronger live evidence or maintainer sponsorship justifies new config and pause-state surface.

recommendation.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
recommendation.body: Add the behavior to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live proof and a future path to generalize if users need it across channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows steipete touching WhatsApp config, access-control, and adjacent channel policy surfaces, and the decision spans config/product policy.
